자기 자신으로 살아가는 게 얼마나 용기 있는 일인지
여러분 덕분에 매일, 무대 위에서 증명할 수 있었습니다.

난 롤라였고,
조금 더 대담해졌고,
조금 더 자유로워졌고,
조금 더 ‘나’다워졌습니다.

세상이 뭐라고 하든,
우린 우리가 원하는 모습으로 빛날 자격이 있잖아요?

그래서 오늘, 이 마지막 무대에서도
나는 가장 높은 힐을 신고, 가장 당당하게 걸어 나갑니다.

Raise you up
여러분도, 나도, 있는 그대로 가장 빛나는 존재니까.

광주, 대구, 부산에서 만나요 ❤️‍🔥

en-US.title: [Kinky Boots] Goodbye Kinky Boots | Kang Hong-seok (Lee Jae-hwan) Final Performance Stage Greeting 👞
en-US.description:
Kinky Boots

💌 A heartfelt message from Hongseok, Lola

Thanks to all of you, I was able to prove on stage every day just how courageous it takes to live as yourself.

I was Lola,

and I became a little bolder,

a little freer,

and a little more like myself.

No matter what the world says,

we deserve to shine the way we want to be, don't we?

Your cheers and applause were not just simple sounds,

but a power that said, "Yes, it’s okay just the way you are."

So today, on this final stage,

I am walking out in the highest heels, with the most confidence.

Raise you up,

because you and I are the most radiant beings, just as we are.

Thank you for staying with us until the end.

The Seoul performances are over, but

See you in Gwangju, Daegu, and Busan ❤️‍🔥

Charlie ✦ Lee Jae-hwan

Lola ✦ Kang Hong-seok

Don ✦ Shim Jae-hyun

Lauren ✦ Heo Yun-seul
